admission.justification: Realized across controlplane/held_reset_index.py, serving/held_reset_scheduler.py, and serving/_app_lifespan.py, and guarded by generation-fencing and restart-survival proofs in mcp/tests/test_held_reset_delivery.py.

applicability: Provider-limited held messages with a known reset timestamp persisted across dashboard restarts and separate MCP/CLI writers.
conditions: HeldResetIndex stores one generation-fenced row per waiting recipient in <coordination_root>/temp/held-resets.sqlite ordered by (next_attempt, agent), gated by require_durable_write_target on writes and read-only URI opens on reads.

run_held_reset_scheduler runs dedicated coordinator and 16-worker delivery pools, rechecking the indexed head every 3 seconds or waking earlier at the head timestamp independently of the 15-second ordinary sweep.
finish_reset_entry inspects the held store under exclusive_file_lock and retires the observed generation only when messages and pendingLines are both empty or the receipt is gone.
exclusions: Ordinary non-limited held messages without a reset timestamp continue to rely on turn-end drains and the rotating receipt sweep.
statement: The reset schedule is a durable control-plane index that survives restarts and wakes delivery independently of the ordinary receipt cursor.
title: Durable reset index and independent wake scheduler
